description: This file defines the Statistics controller class for handling event-based updates to reporting statistics within the OpenCart system. It includes methods for updating statistics when reviews are added, returns are processed, or order statuses change.

classes.name: Statistics
classes.description: Controller class handling event triggers related to reporting statistics such as reviews, returns, and order status changes.

methods.name: addReview
methods.description: Increments the review count in statistics whenever a review is added.

methods.name: addReturn
methods.description: Increments the return count in statistics whenever a return is added.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Updates statistical data related to order statuses, including sales, processing, and completion metrics, when order history changes occur.
